phases.name: scoping
phases.note: SCOPE-124 authored from 8 field reports across 5 projects; preflight 100 (scored 57 on first attempt, blocked by the very marker check FR-007 fixes)

openQuestions: How list_open_items exposes spec identity (FR-004): a specs[] collection, or specNumber resolved onto each task.
Whether FR-005 document identity is enforced by a unique index or in application code. Leaning application-level to keep the scope DDL-free.
What FR-008 does with a duplicate that has since diverged. Deleting edited work on an inference is not acceptable.
Whether FR-007 needs an escape for authors legitimately writing about markers — answered by this scope own document, which could not be filed until it stopped naming them.

decisions.decision: FR-001 shipped as a standalone hotfix (commit 316ffef4), deployed to the hosted MCP, ahead of the rest of the scope.
decisions.rationale: The batch-by-area rule exists because every kit release costs the customer an upgrade. mcp-server auto-deploys on push and costs them nothing, so the rule is: batch what customers must install, ship what they do not. FR-001 was live in production and crossed a tenant boundary.
decisions.consequence: Recorded as SOC 2 finding NEW-12 in project-documentation/SOC2_RELEASE_REVIEW_2026-08-05.md. T001 is already done.

decisions.rationale: A blocked customer knows they are blocked; a corrupted board gets believed. This cluster is also larger (8 reports across 5 projects vs 5 across 2) and has no predecessor, whereas 123 waits on SCOPE-122.
decisions.consequence: 123 and 124 still ship in the same kit release.

ddl: prefer none — FR-005 should achieve idempotency in application code rather than adding an index
dependsOn: SCOPE-098 FR-005 (project.delete_scope, T007-T009, not built) is required by FR-008
